purpose: Public structural inspiration only. No identities or operational school datasets copied.
date_policy: All fixture dates are illustrative fixed 2026-27 examples. Coincidence with published dates does not establish policy, completeness or an imported institutional calendar.

isb-curriculum.title: International School Bangkok: curriculum
isb-curriculum.influence: Early childhood and elementary, Grades 6-8 middle, Grades 9-12 high; distinct AP and IB senior pathways.
isb-curriculum.limits: Fictional subjects and choices; no accreditation or affiliation claimed.

isb-calendar.title: International School Bangkok: public calendar
isb-calendar.influence: Separate teaching dates, closures, family conferences and division-specific events.
isb-calendar.limits: No event feed, personal event text or operational calendar imported.

smc-calendar.title: Santa Monica College: dates and deadlines
smc-calendar.influence: Fall and spring semesters, winter and summer sessions, overlapping full, eight-week and twelve-week blocks.
smc-calendar.limits: Demo dates, deadlines and course combinations do not define college registration rules.

smc-programmes.title: Santa Monica College: degrees and certificates
smc-programmes.influence: Associate/transfer, certificate and noncredit learning goals.
smc-programmes.limits: No degree completion, financial aid, transfer eligibility or policy calculation.

edb-kindergarten.title: Hong Kong Education Bureau: kindergarten overview
edb-kindergarten.influence: Nursery, lower and upper kindergarten, approximately ages 3-6; half-day and whole-day contexts.
edb-kindergarten.limits: K1/K2/K3 is the generic EDB pattern; AM/PM fixture cohorts are disjoint. Whole-day scheduling is not implemented.

esf-kindergarten.title: ESF Tsing Yi International Kindergarten: school profile
esf-kindergarten.limits: ESF is a two-year K1/K2 example, not the source of the demo's K3 pattern. No ESF admissions or progression guarantee copied.

esf-calendar.title: ESF: 2026-27 school calendar, version 1
esf-calendar.limits: Public version is provisional evidence. Fixture dates are fictional; no kindergarten-specific adoption established.

sevenoaks-curriculum.title: Sevenoaks School: curriculum overview
sevenoaks-curriculum.influence: Lower/Middle School, Sixth Form and IB senior study with distinct subject choices.
sevenoaks-curriculum.limits: Fictional subjects and programmes; no reproduction of the school's course catalogue.

sevenoaks-calendar.title: Sevenoaks School: 2026-27 term and key dates
sevenoaks-calendar.influence: Michaelmas/Lent/Summer terms, half terms, staff preparation and separate boarding movements.
sevenoaks-calendar.limits: No published boarding, partial-day or admissions event becomes an automatic school closure.
